recognize_zh: 周邊血液中四顆中型淋巴細胞，核質比高、染色質中度凝集，細胞質極少，且每顆細胞邊緣都有一簇細胞質小突起（cytoplasmic blebs），核輪廓略不規則，是 T-PLL 的典型形態。
features: Four intermediate-sized lymphoid cells of similar appearance
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Distinct polar cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions on each cell
Round to slightly irregular nuclear contours with moderately condensed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous; background red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows four monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm forming distinct surface blebs. Nucleoli are not conspicuous in these cells. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; diagnosis requires immunophenotyping and demonstration of TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have clumped soccer-ball chromatin, lack cytoplasmic blebs and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and are CD7-negative, whereas T-PLL cells have round nuclei with blebs and strong CD7.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi but are B cells with more abundant cytoplasm and sometimes plasmacytoid features.
